rationale: SolarWinds' product page describes Dameware Remote Everywhere as a cloud-based remote support solution with remote control, attended/unattended support, Wake-on-LAN, system information, and device troubleshooting. This is substantial conventional product functionality. SolarWinds AI found in vendor navigation pertains to separate portfolio initiatives, not Dameware; no applicable AI feature was found in DRE product documentation. Non-AI is supported for the documented product offering, with the caveat that no release is named.
version_scope: Undated source description; official current product page and linked administrator/getting-started guides concern Dameware Remote Everywhere, but exact historical release applicability is not specified.
issues: Current product documentation does not establish the exact version represented by the undated record.

sources.excerpt: Dameware Remote Everywhere is a fast, simple, and lightweight cloud-based remote support solution ... Establish secure active sessions ... DRE helps you solve it fast ... Complete attended or unattended support sessions or use Wake-on-LAN to remotely access and troubleshoot sleeping and powered-off devices.
sources.applicability: Product-specific official page provides broad core feature coverage for identified remote support offering; AI is not necessary to its documented function.

sources.excerpt: Dameware Remote Everywhere is designed for users looking for a cloud-based solution and a fast and easy remote control tool to support various devices and systems, from Windows, Linux, and macOS to iOS and Android.
sources.applicability: Assigned source description aligns with the official conventional remote-control product documentation.
